recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
Task: selective SSE delivery by user and client.
Implemented request client ID context helpers, header/cookie middleware and router ordering, per-UI-instance UUID headers, broker context-aware filtering and subscriber IDs, diode put API, cookie expiry constant, and call-site updates. Added focused middleware and delivery tests. Initial offline Go test command "'`GOPROXY=off go test ./server/events ./server ./server/subsonic ./scanner ./model/request` passed before the final test additions; scanner emitted an existing TagLib deprecation warning. Final checks pending.
EOF
GOPROXY=off go test ./server/events ./server ./server/subsonic ./scanner ./model/request'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('server/events/sse_filter_test.go'); s=p.read_text().replace('if "'!broadcast.deliverTo(client{username: "bob", clientUniqueId: "window-a"}) {'"\\n\\t\\tt.Fatal(\"background event was filtered\")\\n\\t}', 'if "'!broadcast.deliverTo(client{username: "bob", clientUniqueId: "window-a"}) {'"\\n\\t\\tt.Fatal(\"background event was filtered\")\\n\\t}\\n\\tb.SendMessage(request.WithUsername(context.Background(), \"alice\"), &RefreshResource{})\\n\\tif "'!(<-b.publish).deliverTo(client{username: "bob"}) {'"\\n\\t\\tt.Fatal(\"event without a client ID was filtered\")\\n\\t}') ; p.write_text(s)
PY
gofmt -w server/events/sse_filter_test.go
GOPROXY=off go test ./server/events ./server"

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
